entities.summary: Charles Winston Chapman was a Canadian basketball player who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. Born in Vancouver, he played in four games, including the final, for the Canadian basketball team which won the silver medal. He was the older brother of Art Chapman, who also played at the Berlin Games.
